_doc: Per-section layout variants for program siblings, keyed by data-module index (0-based, document order): band colour (`tint-<name>`, measured on the live full-page capture stardust/current/assets/screenshots/<slug>.png — background runs at x=6) and media side (`reverse` = media on the left / list on the left for accordions). `dark` = the protect card painted forest with white ink (live /employee-service/). Emitted as variant classes on the block; the sv- block CSS paints them. Legacy pages default to the body grey (#f8f9f9), so their white bands are explicit. `<i>.media` = an editorial picture the live section paints as a CSS background (dropped by the render), appended as the section's media cell. `!<name>` drops a render variant (why-zendesk hero: the live 6/12 + 5/12 teaser, not the `image` 5/12 + 6/12). Hero-only: `small` (live heading variant h2), `landscape` (4:3 media box); columns: `banner` (forest CTA card).
